transcript:
Caller: My appointment request is still unresolved.
Representative: I will pass it to scheduling.

Caller: Nobody has sorted out my consultation booking yet.
Representative: I can forward your message.

Caller: Please call me back to discuss available consultation times.
Representative: I have noted your request.

Caller: I would like someone to return my call about appointment availability.
Representative: Your message is recorded.

Caller: When can I book a consultation?
Representative: I will call you tomorrow with the available times.

Caller: Could you check the schedule?
Representative: I promise to phone you in the morning with an update.

Representative: Your appointment is Thursday at ten.
Caller: That answers my question. No further help is needed.

Representative: The consultation is confirmed for Thursday morning.
Caller: Perfect, everything is settled. Goodbye.

Caller: Is this the bicycle repair shop?
Representative: No, this is a legal office.
Caller: Sorry, I dialed the wrong number. Goodbye.

Caller: I was trying to reach a florist.
Representative: You have reached a law office.
Caller: My mistake, wrong business. I do not need anything.

Caller: My booking is still unresolved.
Representative: I have now booked the time you requested.
Caller: Yes, the confirmation arrived. That resolves it; nothing else is needed.

Caller: Nobody has fixed my appointment problem yet.
Representative: I have corrected the booking now.
Caller: I can see the correct time. It is sorted out and no follow-up is needed.

Caller: I was calling about my appointment and wanted to ask...
[recording ends]

Caller: There is something about the consultation time that I...
[recording ends before the question]

Caller: My question is both resolved and not resolved; I cannot explain which.
Representative: I do not have enough information to clarify that.
[call ends]

Caller: It is fixed and it is not fixed at the same time. I cannot clarify.
Representative: We have no clarification before the call ends.

Representative: Your appointment is confirmed.
Caller: That resolves my question, but please still call me tomorrow to confirm it again.

Caller: The booking issue is sorted out now. I would still like a return call in the morning for reassurance.
Representative: I have noted that request.

Representative: Did the explanation answer your question?
Caller: I am not sure whether...
[recording ends]

Representative: Is there anything still outstanding?
Caller: I cannot tell from the information I have.
[call ends without clarification]
